result.summary: The page is largely coherent, but the first card in 'Popular right now' has a broken/failed image that leaves a grey placeholder box, and several smaller inconsistencies exist (truncated restaurant name without ellipsis, mismatched favorite-button styling, low-contrast heart icon).

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' shows a generic broken-image icon on a grey block instead of the restaurant photo, making the card look unfinished compared to all other cards.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/asset loading and add a branded fallback (e.g. cuisine illustration or logo with restaurant name) instead of the default broken-image glyph.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is clipped by the viewport and its title reads 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis or fade, so it looks like broken text rather than a scrollable row.
issues.suggestion: Add text-overflow ellipsis for card titles and a right-edge gradient/peek offset so the carousel visibly indicates more content is scrollable.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button styling is inconsistent between the two 'Popular right now' cards: grey semi-transparent circle on the broken-image card versus dark circle on the pizza card, and the grey version has weak icon contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent button treatment (e.g. solid white/dark scrim with fixed opacity) so the heart icon meets contrast requirements over any background.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is cut off abruptly by the bottom tab bar with no spacing, so the card appears sliced rather than scrolling under a bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scroll container equal to the tab bar height, and consider a translucent/blur tab bar so content clipping reads intentionally.

issues.description: Category filter chips row is cut mid-chip at the right edge with no visual affordance, which can hide available filters from users.
issues.suggestion: Show a partial chip with a fade indicator or scroll arrow, and ensure chips are keyboard/screen-reader navigable with selected state announced.
